# Online Quest & Item Creator

## Post 4335 by Torta (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2019-10-29T16:15:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=4335#p4335 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Hello, young turtle developers,

Our web-development turtle Xerron's created an online DB Tool which generates queries compatible with Turtle WoW and [VMaNGoS](https://github.com/vmangos/core/commits/development) world database structures.

Create new amazing items or quests, use it on your local playground or share them with you friends.

<https://dev.turtlecraft.gg>

 **Quest Contest:**

Create an quest for your favorite location and share the link in this thread. We will pick the most interesting ones and add them to the game! The quest should be lore appropriate and story should fit to the game lore and do not conflict with the existing stories.

![Image](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/images/turtlewow_dbtool_1.jpg)

Please contact Xerron#0246 in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/mBGxmHy) if you have questions.

Developer note: please don't use special characters ( üöä, /, —, etc) in the editor, it will bug out your save.

## Post 4338 by Qixel (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2019-10-29T19:25:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=4338#p4338 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I made a high level shaman quest chain. I couldn't figure out how to make a quest starting item, or how to determine quest ids for the quests, so I hope you'll forgive me the incompletion.

[A Softly Glowing Shard](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) begins from [A Softly Glowing Shard], which would have a  very low chance to drop from various 55+ enemies.

Completing that quest leads you to [A Test of Strength](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), in which the shaman must dispatch three high level enemies.

After doing so, you recieve the raid quest, [Punish the Firelord's Betrayal](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!). I had always thought it kind of dumb that half of the bosses of Molten Core had a quest to kill them, but the other half did not, which inspired this quest. The objective is to kill Magmadar, Garr, Baron Geddon, and Golemagg. Upon completion, you receive a totem, the [[Wind-Kissed Shard]](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Finally, you recieve a quest to slay Ragnaros himself, [The Firelord's Fall](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!). Upon completion, the shaman recieves [[Stormfrenzy, Vengeful Glaive of the Windlord]](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

## Post 4644 by Qixel (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2019-12-16T07:41:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=4644#p4644 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Was feeling nostalgic (likely a side effect of beating Rag), so I made this quest.

[Help A Gnome Out](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcreator/WzAsMCwyLDQ0MCw0MCw1MCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsIkhlbHAgQSBHbm9tZSBPdXQiLCIkRyBEdWRlOkNoaWNhLCBvdmVyIGhlcmUhXG4kQlxuJEJJIG5lZWQgYSBmYXZvciEgVGhlcmUncyB0aGlzIGJpZyBhbmltYWwgdGhpbmcgaW4gVW5vIENyYXRlciwgcmlnaHQ~~) is obtained from a silly little gnome in Gadgetzan. She wants you to help her with collecting bloodpetal sprouts from the un'goro crater, and will pay for the assistance in gold and [pizza bottles](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (burritos).

Story behind the quest (spoilered because it's unimportant and potentially sad?) My mom was the one who got me into WoW. She was playing MMOs since before Everquest launched, but WoW was the first time I got to play alongside her. I have a lot of fond memories watching from behind her while she raided with her guild, and her main raiding character was Reas, the gnome rogue.

The two big things to know about mom in regards to this quest: She had no qualms hiring children to get things for her (This quest is a direct reference to when she had me farm bloodpetal sprouts for her when she was too busy so she could get the recipe for the Elixir of Brute Force, in fact. She ended up getting it herself in the end. xD), and she had trouble calling things by their proper names. Gadgetron was the big one in Vanilla, and Burning Crusade had Shatner City in Terracotta Forest. It's been a long time since she played and I don't remember if there was a mom-ism for Un'goro, so I called it something that sounded right for her. 'Pizza bottles' was what she called burritos literally one time, and no one in the family ever let her live it down; first of all because it's so completely wrong, and secondly because it's hilarious.

Double spoilered because it's def sad territory now She passed away unexpectedly last year. I came back to Turtle at a low point because I wanted to recapture the feeling I had exploring Azeroth with her all those years ago. When I did, I never would have expected to be raiding, much less participating in the server first kill of Ragnaros. I wish I could tell her about it, say I made it, too. If you've read this far, I apologize for being sappy and shit, but I double spoilered it. This is on you. If you still have your mom, let her know you care. Call her up. Don't put it off. You never know how much time you have.

## Post 4852 by Sinrek (Grandmaster of Forum PvP) — 2020-01-10T16:19:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=4852#p4852 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

While you create a quest, please make sure you think through all the process. Level at which a player could have access to the quest, place where the quest item is found, circumstances and options limiting the player or rather directing them further down your quest and the endpoint of your quest where the player should finish it.

Minor stuff, however, it all matters greatly if you take into account that player might have absolute zero experience in games whatsoever.

Of course, there are some quests that heavily imply players to be familiar both with gaming and the world they particularly are at the moment. Of course, there are quests with very vague descriptions and almost a riddle to solve, but those are completely another story when it comes for new levellers.

I like the initiative of your quest. Hope there won't be any need for additional scripting for the quest. Keep it up!

## Post 4881 by Qixel (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2020-01-16T19:00:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=4881#p4881 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

It always bugged me that after beating Sunken Temple, you start a questline that immediately rewards you a trinket, then asks you to get rid of the trinket to progress the questline. Not necessarily an issue, aside from the fact the questline abruptly ends two quests later, meaning you gave up the trinket to save the rough equivalent of ten or fifteen mob kills. Turning in the quest is a mistake at this point. Now, Blizzard did finish that storyline in the Sceptre of the Shifting Sands questline, but it's entirely unconnected to the Sunken Temple one. So I decided to make a sort of in-between quest that connects the two quest lines narratively and rewards a different trinket.

Spoiling for those who have never done the chain, however few there are, aha.
Continuing from [In Eranikus' Own Words](https://classic.wowhead.com/quest=3512/in-eranikus-own-words), Umbranse the Spiritspeaker sends you to kill the satyr known as Lavathra, who stole his [augury device](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) in the new followup, [A Foul Thief](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~). Lavathra is an elite mob that I would say ought to be on par with an early LBRS boss in terms of difficulty, making it an elite quest.

Once the device has been recovered, players return to Umbranse so he can begin his [Communion with Eranikus](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) within the Dream. After discovering Eranikus' corruption, Umbranse sends to to be the [Bearer of Bad News](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) to Itharius, who rewards you with a choice of three new trinkets.

Inspired by the Signet Rings of the Bronze Dragonflight, there's a trinket for [Physical DPS](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), [Magical DPS](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), and [Hybrid DPS](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!). I named them with numbers because not doing so was tricking the creator into thinking they were the same item. They should all have the same name like the Signet Rings, but if that's not possible, changing the names based upon the flavor text would suffice.

Not necessarily an issue, aside from the fact the questline abruptly ends two quests later, meaning you gave up the trinket to save the rough equivalent of ten or fifteen mob kills. So I decided to make a sort of in-between quest that connects the two quest lines narratively and rewards a different trinket.
>
>  Spoiling for those who have never done the chain, however few there are, aha.
>  Continuing from [In Eranikus' Own Words](https://classic.wowhead.com/quest=3512/in-eranikus-own-words), Umbranse the Spiritspeaker sends you to kill the satyr known as Lavathra, who stole his [augury device](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) in the new followup, [A Foul Thief](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~). Lavathra is an elite mob that I would say ought to be on par with an early LBRS boss in terms of difficulty, making it an elite quest.
>
>  Once the device has been recovered, players return to Umbranse so he can begin his [Communion with Eranikus](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) within the Dream. After discovering Eranikus' corruption, Umbranse sends to to be the [Bearer of Bad News](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) to Itharius, who rewards you with a choice of three new trinkets.
>
>  Inspired by the Signet Rings of the Bronze Dragonflight, there's a trinket for [Physical DPS](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), [Magical DPS](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), and [Hybrid DPS](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!). I named them with numbers because not doing so was tricking the creator into thinking they were the same item. They should all have the same name like the Signet Rings, but if that's not possible, changing the names based upon the flavor text would suffice.

That always bothered me too! I really like your idea, however I'd choose different names for each trinket and maybe nerf them a little bit too.

## Post 5526 by Velite (Patch Note Conspiracy Theorist) — 2020-03-26T04:10:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=5526#p5526 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Made a trinket that gives a taunt effect. Now I know that this might be too much of an imbalanced item, but I made it have a 3 min cd, and the idea is that anybody can use it and I am open to the idea of it being a reward much later down the line if it shouldn't be too accessible. But the intention is; that Blizzard did not give paladins taunt because shamans did not have taunt and it would be imbalanced (despite giving paladins a tree fully intended for tanking already); Considering that this server has cross faction raiding so both paladins and shamans are present in the raid, we could give a taunt usable for paladins as a situational ability. This is similar to the rationale in tbc because both factions had paladins and shamans so Blizzard didn't need to balance them as equal to each other in their capabilities, so they gave paladins a taunt that was not equal to warrior taunt but at least existed. Obviously it would need to be balanced since there is the possiblity that it allows anyone to break hunter cc by taunting pet, and that it allows a rogue to situationally tank using evasion and taunt, or paladin bubble and taunt, so there can be some work in seeing how it can be implemented.

This could potentially be tanking class restricted, and it could be a mocking blow effect instead.

## Post 6204 by Dragunovi (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2020-06-04T11:23:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6204#p6204 | page 2 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

"**Dalaran has always been a mystery in Vanilla WoW, does nothing happen inside there? It was mostly uneventful until several houses were suddenly set aflame. Because of his interest in the flame Archmage Rathiel was blamed. He was soon kicked out of Dalaran, finding himself in Booty Bay. He now looks for someone that could help him continue his fiery experiments.**"

You can now find [Archmage Rathiel](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) sitting in one of the empty tables in **The Salty Sailor Tavern** in **Booty Bay**.

The first quest he offers you is [A Fiery Experiment](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) He wants you to collect ingredients all around Azeroth. The list he provides is [Rathiel's List](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), it reads:
 **Page 1:** The first ingredient i need is Fire Oil. Alchemists make them using Firefin Snappers, a fish you can catch in any shoreline. Ten vials of Fire Oil should suffice.

 **Page 2:** The second ingredient i need is Small Flame Sacs. You can get them from the whelps in northeast parts of Wetlands and southwestern part of the Swamp of Sorrows. Bring me five.

 **Page 3:** The last ingredient i need is Elemental Fire. You can get it only from the mighty fire elementals. I heard they roam around the Charred Vale in Stonetalon Mountains. Only one is enough.

 **Page 4:** Bring these to me and i'll look at what i can make with them.

When you bring 10 [Fire Oils](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=6371/fire-oil), 5 [Small Flame Sacs](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=4402/small-flame-sac) and an [Elemental Fire](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=7068/elemental-fire) you will be rewarded with [Orb of Fire](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=12805/orb-of-fire), a trinket that gives your melee attacks a chance to blast your target for some fire damage, also works in druid forms!) and 5 [Elixirs of Fire Breath](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

The next quest is [A Fiery Experiment pt.2](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~) Archmage Rathiel asks you to collect 10 [Pure Flames](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) from [Burning Exiles](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=2760/burning-exile) in northwestern Arathi Highlands with a %40 drop chance.

The reward is [Orb of Fiery Blast](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a 5 charge usable item that shoots a fireball at your target)

The third and last quest is [A Fiery Experiment pt.3](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) which wants you to get [Crusted Lava Core](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) from [Emberfist](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), an elite level 40 molten elemental that can pulse fire damage to those around it, and has slightly more damage, health and armor from a normal elite, bring your friends!), an earth elemental that has absorbed the fiery breath of the drakes residing in the Badlands, pathing around the Lethlor Ravine in eastern Badlands.

When you find something (aka find the **Crusted Lava Core**) he will give you the ability to choose one of his five experimental fire-imbued armaments.

[Scorchshot](Those%20are%20https%3A//dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a crossbow that does extra fire damage)
[Obsidion](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), an unnaturaly fast polearm that has a chance to do a multi-attack)
[Flameberge](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a reference to the Flamberge sword that deals extra fire damage and has a chance to proc a little extra fire blast)
[Fireblast Shield](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a shield that has a %1 chance to do a small fire nova when hit)
[Fireshard](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a fast wand that can fire blast your target on use with a 15 minute cooldown.)

SOLUTION:
Google docs replaces text as you type. Apostrophes **'** and ellipses **...** are replaced with single special characters (not allowed, see previous posts regarding issues with them) and will mess up the save to the browser. Write your quests without those punctuation marks if collaborating with GoogleDocs, copy and paste your text to the tool and fix the marks in the editor as you create the quest. Should then save properly.

## Post 6399 by Rhaco — 2020-06-17T18:28:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6399#p6399 | page 3 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

A goblin named Rezlak was charged with helping the orcs out in Durotar, but he's been having trouble with logistics. The caravan that was PROMISED to make it to Orgrimmar was ambushed by harpies...

- First, Rezlak introduces himself and asks you to get back his stuff in the quest [*Winds in the Desert*](https://classic.wowhead.com/quest=834/winds-in-the-desert).
Adding to this story, players can now find out that the harpies also got their claws on some weaponry. A new tandem quest [**TRIGGERED**](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~) will have players picking up [Kaja's Ammo](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (from object=176785/ammo-crate) while they are already in Razorwind Canyon.
 - Next, players are sent to end the harpy danger to the shipping route with the quest [*Securing the Lines*](https://classic.wowhead.com/quest=835/securing-the-lines)
 - Previously, *Winds in the Desert* ended with Rezlak still looking for someone to haul the sacks for him. That story thread is now completed when he asks players to complete the journey because [**THE MAIL MUST GO THROUGH**](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~~2FICRiJGIgT2ggdGhlIHN1cHBsaWVzIG1hZGUgaXQgZWg~). Players will deliver [Rezlak's Shipment](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) to his cousin Kozlish in Orgrimmar, who was an NPC without purpose... up til now!
 - Kozlish rudely decides to protect his own interests and sends players to deliver the ammo themselves in the new quest [**OUT FOR DELIVERY.**](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Thus, new players get one of their first tastes of chaining quests early in the game. We see a satisfying conclusion to a storyline, as well as a bit of lore on goblin business practices and job security. Rezlak and Kozlish are looking for work (and maybe a hole to hide in from Gazlowe!) and can potentially show up later in the game as well.
 *Stay tuned to find out why Rezlak sent Kozlish on to Orgrimmar and needed you to finish the job in the first place...*

The creation tool indicates reputation is awarded automatically by the server. Is this correct or should creators make certain to fill in those areas when writing new quests?

## Post 6466 by Mac (Bug Report Enthusiast) — 2020-06-20T08:32:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6466#p6466 | page 3 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

This is my first attempt at making quests and items.  It's a chain of quests set in Duskwood that use NPCs and spots that the existing quests for the most part ignore.

PART 1: [A Grave Injustice](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!): Talk to Watcher Paige, who wants you to investigate grave robberies in Raven Hill Cemetery.  Kill a grave robber, who will drop a [Grave Robber's Shovel](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (quest item, 100% drop rate) that says it's property of Yorgen.  Return to Watcher Paige.

PART 2: [The Defias of Duskwood](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!): Watcher Paige points out that the shovel came from Yorgen Farmstead, which is currently overrun by the Defias Brotherhood.  Therefore, the Defias are behind the grave robberies (in game, the grave robber npcs are on Defias faction and can even drop Defias masks, so it actually fits the lore).  She wants you to bring justice to the Defias by killing 5 Defias Night Blades, 5 Defias Night Runners, and 1 Defias Enchanter (these can be found in either Yorgen Farmstead or Addle's Stead).

PART 3: [Report Back to Darkshire](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!): Watcher Paige wants you to report back to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.

PART 4: [Law & Ogre](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~): Having proven yourself capable of bringing order to chaos, Commander Althea Ebonlocke gives you your final task: bring the Splinter Fist Ogres to justice.  You need to kill 5 Splinter Fist Warriors, 3 Splinter Fist Fire Mongers, 3 Splinter Fist Fire Weavers, and 2 Splinter Fist Taskmasters at the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound.  Do this and you get to choose one of two quest rewards.

The first quest reward is [Smoldering Brand](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).  I always found it weird that Duskwood quests never gave you torch item even though the Night Watch use torches.  This is an offhand mace with a little fire damage to it.  It requires you have your Survival skill at 10, which is fairly easy to obtain.  In lieu of stats, I put Fire's Glow on it since it's a torch.

The second quest reward is [Healing Hands](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).  These are some cloth caster gloves that come with three charges of Renew (rank 4).  The charges don't seem to show up on the preview, though.

Let me know what you think of the quest.

Hello Team!
Frog and my recently added quest has a few oopses on our part in it, as well as changes that I don't think were intentional. The quest was submitted requiring the killing of 10 Scarlet Magicians but was implemented with the requirement of killing 10 Scarlet Sentries. There aren't enough of them in one pass and it doesn't draw people to the garden as the quest name implies. Along with that, the items submitted had errors on our part in that we left a sell price off of each item. We will get it right the first time eventually! The mace, Scarlet Pillar was supposed to be two-handed. I didn't realize there were two windows to set as a 2 hander. ## Post 6576 by Mac (Bug Report Enthusiast) — 2020-06-25T11:51:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6576#p6576 | page 3 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Here are three more quests, this time for Ashenvale.  One is for the Horde, one is for Alliance, and one is for both.

The first quest is for the Horde.  [Report to Shatterskull](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!): This is a bread crumb quest meant to lead you to the quest giver.  It's not required to do.

[Legacy of the Legion](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!): Collect 15 [Marks of the Burning Legion](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) from demons in the Felfire Hill/Demon Fall Canyon area.  These demons are [Mannoroc Lasher](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=11697/mannoroc-lasher), [Felguard](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=6115/felguard), and [Searing Infernal](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=6073/searing-infernal).  Drop rate should be about 80% (not every time, but usually).

Rewards: [Demonic Claws](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) or [Ring of Rage](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), and 200 [Razor Arrows](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=3030/razor-arrow).

Next quest is for Alliance.  [Report to Farsong](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~): Again, this is another optional bread crumb trail to the quest giver.

[The Song of War](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!): This quest has you go into Warsong Lumber Camp and kill orcs for 15 [Warsong Axes](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).  These will drop off [Horde Deforesters](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=11681/horde-deforester), [Horde Grunts](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=11682/horde-grunt), [Horde Peons](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=11656/horde-peon), [Horde Scouts](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=11680/horde-scout), and [Horde Shamen](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=11683/horde-shaman).  Again, like an 80% drop rate should be good.

Rewards: [Band of Ivy](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) or [Orcfoe](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), and 200 [Razor Arrows](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=3030/razor-arrow).

The final quest line is for both Horde and Alliance.  It starts by looting the [Cursed Medallion](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) off [Diathorus the Seeker](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=6072/diathorus-the-seeker) who is currently deep in a barrow den in Demon Fall Ridge.  This starts the quest [The Cursed Medallion](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~2FICBXaHksIHllcywgSSd2ZSBoZWFyZCBzdG9yaWVzIGJlZm9yZS4iLCJXaGF0IGlzIGl0IHlvdSB3YW50IHRvIGFzayBhYm91dCwgJFI~).

If you follow the clue, you wind up talking to [Krazek](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=773/krazek) in Booty Bay.  He gives you [Securing the Cure](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~), which has you go kill [Bloodmage Thalnos](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=4543/bloodmage-thalnos) in Scarlet Monastery (Graveyard) to loot [Distilled Essence of Holy Light](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) off of him.  That leads to the quest [Seek Strahad Farsan](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) where you go to Booty Bay and talk to [Strahad Farsan](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=6251/strahad-farsan).  This leads to the final quest, [The Cured Medallion](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~), where you give him the medallion, the essence, and 50 silver (not sure if I did that right in the quest maker) to get the reward, [Medallion of Might](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).

Any feedback is appreciated.

 *Edited the icon and name of Cured Medallion to Medallion of Might.

One of the best features of Turtle WoW is hardcore mode, but some new players may have been too excited to try out our server before reading ALL of the website information. A quest from Speedy is the perfect way to bring attention to Hardcore Mode so that they can choose whether or not they want to give it a try before it's too late at level 2.

In [**SLOW AND STEADY**](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcreator/WzYwMTE1LDAsMiwwLDEsMSwxLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsIlNsb3cgYW5kIFN0ZWFkeSIsIkhlbGxvISBNeSBuYW1lIGlzIFNwZWVkeS4kYiRiIEknbSBhIHR1cnRsZSBhbmQgSSBsaWtlIHRvIHRha2UgaXQgc2xvdy4gTGlmZSBpcyB0b28gc2hvcnQgdG8gcnVuIGl0IGxpa2UgYSByYWNlLCBkb24ndCB5b3UgdGhpbms~), Speedy will introduce himself and invite you to be a part of his turtle club. If Players choose to accept the Glyph of Hardcore, it goes into their keyring and the quest is complete. They may instead choose a [Rabbit Foot](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=3300/rabbits-foot) to complete the quest, in which case they may continue on their adventures at a normal non-turtley pace.

(GMs, please fill in the Glyph of Hardcore item# to finish quest creation. If you have another NPC besides Speedy who would be a better choice, feel free to use them!)

## Post 6687 by Balake (Bug Report Enthusiast) — 2020-07-03T13:13:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6687#p6687 | page 4 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Shamans overall don't want leather, that is true. No class wants to wear lower tier armor but it is a sacrifice they have to make. Sometimes you gotta wear a weaker armor type item because it has stronger stats, that's how vanilla works, and it is a good thing. PvP and PvE have different itemization. For PvP, it's best to wear the highest armor type even if its a bit weaker in stats than other items just for the extra armor, but in PvE the armor is not that useful so they wear lower armor types with better stats to perform better. Sacrifice survivability for damage, that is why I think to help enh shamans and ret paladins with pve and at the same time not buff them in pvp, the items added need to be leather to fit a glass cannon playstyle that is useless for pvp.

Note: The pvp set is mail because shaman tier sets are mail. that does not prove anything. The argument is about off-set pieces. Classes wear off-set pieces with lower armor types than the max they can wear.

## Post 6716 by Balake (Bug Report Enthusiast) — 2020-07-04T16:52:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6716#p6716 | page 4 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

> **Mrkrissatan wrote: Sat Jul 04, 2020 11:06 am**
> These items should be obtainable from an elite quest that becomes available at level 51, I've done quite a bit of research and believe I have made balanced items this time. If someone can help me with the making the quest part I'd be eternally grateful.
>
>  [Rapture, Betrayer of Darkness](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
>
>  [Soulstring, Last Hope of the Prince](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
>
>  [Oathkeeper, Destroyer of the Earth](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
>
>  [Cosmos, Maul of Titans](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
>
>  [Shadowsteel, Incarnation of Suffering's End](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

The names are ridiculously over-the-top and sound like they drop from Sargeras not from a level 51 quest, if they were to be added to Turtle-wow they need more humble, normal and down-to-earth names and not xd op luls +infinity maximum powah names. And about the balance:

 2H axe is stronger than arcanite reaper and can be obtained 7 levels earlier. No.

The crossbow is basically the same as Bloodseeker from AV (only difference is one point to str vs agi). It is redundant.

Wand needs to only give 16 shadow power to be on par with AV frost wand.

The 1H mace is the same story as the crossbow, only worse because it is a copy of the AV mace BUT IT DEALS **shadow damage** which is insane. Blizzard tried to add an item that deals purely magical damage in tbc. It was hotfixed quickly because it is a broken dumb idea. There is this thing called armor that every creature in the game has. Shadow damage instead of physical is basically a metric ton more damage that may or may not bug out and be exploited somehow with some wonky talents or spellpower gear scaling.

Nothing to say about the polearm. It is a copy/paste of the AV polearm and thus has no reason to exist.

On another note, these are level 51 items with a 63 ilvl. Yes the AV ones also have that ilvl but AV is still a high-end pvp activity. If a 63ilvl item is to be obtainable at 51 it needs to be very challenging to obtain. 63ilvl is higher than level 60 dungeons, and pre-bis items should not be given away like candy at level 51 from a quest unless that is the final quest of a super long super hard multiple-dungeon spanning, epic adventure questline.

However, the potential is huge. With more polishing and balancing work your items can be really great. My advice to you is just keep it more simple and down-to-earth overall to make it feel turtly   turtle_tongue
and ease up with the names lol

## Post 6724 by Dragunovi (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2020-07-04T23:41:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6724#p6724 | page 4 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

**"The Hand is a mysterious organisation, tasking adventurers with the collection of bones and teeth of the savage fauna that resides in Un'goro Crater. Are they just simple poachers or is there something much bigger going behind the veil?"**

The questline either starts with [Bone-Bladed Weapons](https://classic.wowhead.com/quest=4300/bone-bladed-weapons) from [Jes'rimon](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=8659/jesrimon) **(Horde)** or from [Renther Senethril](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), a new NPC that can be found at the top floor of SI:7 in Stormwind. He gives [Bone-Bladed Weapons](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~2FIiwiTXkgY2xpZW50cyBhcmUgbm90IHNvIHBhdGllbnQsICROLiBIYXZlIHlvdSBnb3R0ZW4gYW55IG9mIHRoZSBjbGF3cyB5ZXQ~) **(Alliance)** as first part. (Made it for parity, not that different from horde version.) which makes you collect white claws from the ravasaurs in Un'goro Crater.

The second part is [Wingbone Weaponry](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~) **(Horde Version)** and [Wingbone Weaponry](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcreator/WzYwMTAyLDEsMiw0OTAsNDgsNTIsNjAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsNjAxMDAsNjAxMDQsMCwwLDAsMCwwLCJXaW5nYm9uZSBXZWFwb25yeSIsIllvdSBkaWQgd2VsbCwgIFRoZSBIYW5kIGlzIHBsZWFzZWQuIFRoZXkgaGF2ZSBtb3JlIHJlcXVlc3RzIGZyb20geW91LCBhcmUgeW91IGludGVyZXN0ZWQ~) **(Alliance Version)** which sends you to collect [Pterrodax Wingbone](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) from the pterrodaxes that roam around the crater. Around %70-80 drop chance. The rewards are [Pterrodax Wingbow](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) and [Pterrodax Wingblade](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).

The third part is [Boneplate of the Stegodon](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~) **(Horde Version)** and [Boneplate of the Stegodon](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)  **(Alliance Version)** which sends you to collect [Stegodon Boneplate](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) from the Plated Stegodons in the crater. They drop one for the entire party and they're a %100 drop, it's not easy killing giant armored beasts.
The rewards are [Boneplate Breastplate](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) and [Light Boneplate Leggings](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).

The last part is [Bite of the Devisaur](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) **(Horde Version)** and [Bite of the Devilsaur](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) **(Alliance Version)** which sends you to collect [Devilsaur Tooth](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) from the devilsaurs that roam around all of Un'goro Crater. Same as the stegodons, one drops for all of the party and %100 drop chance. You gotta hunt them all around the crater for this quest, they like to roam the whole zone.

The rewards are [Devilsaur Tooth Necklace](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), [Imbued Devilsaur Claw](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).

## Post 6726 by Mac (Bug Report Enthusiast) — 2020-07-05T02:36:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6726#p6726 | page 4 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

**Azshara, the Zone that Devs Forgot.**  I think I once read that the game developers realized that Azshara was a difficult zone to navigate and just abandoned quests for it halfway through.  I can't vouch if that's true, but it does seem to be considering a quest like [A Crew Under Fire](https://classicdb.ch/?quest=3382) is completely unfinished.  You complete the quest, are told to talk to the surviving passengers, and then... *nothing*.  The quest just repeats for zero reward.  None of the survivors want to say even a single word to you.  WoWWiki speculates the area was meant to be like Faldir's Cove, a little pirate quest hub hidden to the majority of the players.  And so, following that speculation, I've written up some quests for this spot.  The quests are for both Horde and Alliance.

Because of how long this post is, I've spoilered all the info.
 **Optional Step 0) [The Horizon Scout](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~)**. This quest is meant to lead the player to the area, but can be skipped.  Starts with [Fleet Master Seahorn](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=2487/fleet-master-seahorn) in Booty Bay.

 **Step 1) [A Crew Under Fire](https://classicdb.ch/?quest=3382)**.  This quest is in-game, but should be made non-repeatable.  Completing it should not only lead to Step 2, but open up Side Quest A and B.

 **Step 2) [Surveying the Wreckage](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~)**.

 **Step 3) [Under the Sea](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~2FICBXZWxsLCBpdCdzIHByb2JhYmx5IGRvd24gaW4gdGhlIHJlbWFpbnMgb2YgdGhlIEhvcml6b24gU2NvdXQuICBJZiBJIHdlcmUgeW91LCBJJ2QgdGFrZSBhIGRpdmUuICBKdXN0IGJlIGNhcmVmdWwgbm90IHRvIGRpZSBvZiBmYXRpZ3VlLiIsIkludmVzdGlnYXRlIHRoZSByZW1haW5zIG9mIHRoZSBIb3Jpem9uIFNjb3V0IiwiTGluZHJvcz8gIFRoYXQgb2xkIGZvb2w~)**.

 **Step 4) ["Dead" Men Tell No Tales](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~)**.  You deliver [Roland's Mana Gem](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) to [Lindros](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8381).

 **Step 5) [Against the Spitelash](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~)**.  You kill [Caravan Master Tset](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8409) (whose name is a placeholder that the devs never bothered to finish) and get [Lockbox of Artifacts](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), plus kill 10 [Spitelash Sirens](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=6195) and 10 [Spitelash Myrmidons](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=6196).

 **Step 6) [Delivery to Booty Bay](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~2FJEIkQldlbGwsIHdoaWxlIHlvdSBwb25kZXIgeW91ciBmdXR1cmUsIHRha2UgYSByZXdhcmQuICBZb3UndmUgbW9yZSB0aGFuIGVhcm5lciBpdC4iLCJHb3QgYW55IGdvb2QgbmV3cyBmb3IgbWU~)**.  You get to choose one of two rewards.
- **[Pirate Parrying Dagger](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)**

- **[Flowing Sash of the Tide](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)**
You also get a **[Shiny Brass Spyglass](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)**: A trinket that lets you use Humanoid Tracking (a 3 minute duration version of Track Humanoids) with a 90 minute cooldown.

And now for the two side quests.

 **Side Quest A) [Lost Keepsake](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)**.  You have to find [Alexandra's Keepsake](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).  It drops off [Spitelash Sirens](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=6195) or [Spitelash Myrmidons](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=6196) so there's synergy with the main quest.  The drop rate should be fairly low, like Sida's Bag low.  You choose one of three rewards:
- **[Libram of Piety](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)**

- ****[Idol of the Predator](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)****

- ****[Totem of Command](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)****

 ****Side Quest B) [Feeding the Crew](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)****. You need to collect 10 [Chunks of Mosshoof Meat](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) from [Mosshoof Coursers](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8761) and/or [Mosshoof Stags](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8760) (but not Mosshoof Runners, because they're too lean).  You get 5 [Mosshoof Burgers](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) and meat is back on the menu.

 **NOTES)** The following NPCs are not in the game world (I checked) but should be in the database: [Second Mate Shandril](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8478), [Roland Geardabbler](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8394), [Horizon Scout Cook](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8388), [Horizon Scout Engineer](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8389), and [Horizon Scout First Mate](https://classicdb.ch/?npc=8387).  I couldn't get a good location on these guys since they're off map, but [this video from 2008](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SdJg8Vc0KO0&feature=youtu.be&t=120) shows exactly where they belong.

The Horizon Scout itself is partially within fatigue water.  Swimming in, you'll get fatigue.  However, within the captain's room (where Roland Geardabbler should be), you won't suffer from fatigue.

While digging through information on this, I found two unused quests related to this area.  One was to kill Roland, which I nixxed because he's a level 43 and the quest is for level 52s.  Also, he's friendly to everyone.  The other one had you get his mana gem, and it would have been from a container (that also isn't in the game), but I decided to nix that, too, because that container was in fatigue water.

And as a side note, there's apparently a line of 3 minute tracking spells for each type that are learnable by players (as in there's a corresponding spell that teaches it).  They're all called "X Tracking" (like "Humanoid Tracking").  Either this is an early version of the Hunter's track line that they cut, or (as I prefer to believe), it's a line of abilities for another class.  I think it'd really fit Rogues since they have the whole assassin thing going for them, and assassins should be able to track their prey.

I hope this wasn't too much.  I don't know if you have a limit to how many quests or items you can add to the game.  I also hope I made it in time for that final update before the expansion.

Quest rewards like equipment should ideally be bind of pickup rather than bind on equip so you can't turn around and sell them on the AH.  They also don't need a level requirement because of this (just about the only quest reward with a level requirement is [Lightforged Blade](https://classicdb.ch/?item=20504) because Blizzard messed up back in the day and it wasn't BOP, so people gave it to their level 1 warriors and stuff).

I'm not super sold on giving Shaman a Whirlwind weapon, but I do appreciate that you put a caster-focused staff in there to account for the fact that not every Shaman is going to take the Two-Handed Axes and Maces talent.   I also think giving Call of Air a follow-up is a good idea.

## Post 7084 by Rhaco — 2020-07-27T01:00:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7084#p7084 | page 5 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Non-druids miss out on a bit of lore involving the activities up on Dreadmist Peak and how it's poisoning the Barrens. This two-part chain gives all other classes the opportunity to assist in the rescue efforts to save those cute gazelles!

 **14 [DOWN WITH THE SICKNESS](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)** While Tonga Runetotem waits for help to arrive from the Cenarion Circle, he sends non-druids to collect samples while they regretably put down the Sickly Gazelles and keep the poison from spreading higher up the food chain. (*Druids are sent to collect samples from the source of the taint- the water pools atop Dreadmist Peak. Tonga is then able to use that water and the samples you collected to thoroughly study the malady affecting the barrens. He immediately sends druids to collect the ingredients needed for the cure.* )

- **15 [PREVENTING POISON](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~)** You chase down and vaccinate healthy Gazelles with a [Protective Animal Salve](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!). (*While druids find and cure the sickest animals.*)
For your help, you may choose an offhand vial of the [**WATERS OF VISION**](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), (previously a model only available to alliance [Tear of Grief](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=5611/tear-of-grief))
which is intended to be like the druid's item=15866/[veildust-medicine-bag](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=15866/veildust-medicine-bag) with mild stats and on-use mana, but instantly, like a reusable lesser mana potion.
 *This item is incomplete, devs please help balance and finish it*.
or the [**BRAVE'S RIFLE**](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

## Post 7148 by Axoc (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2020-07-31T10:31:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7148#p7148 | page 5 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

One of the two Rogue class quests that was cut from the game is about a named NPC in Bael Modan - Lord Cyrik Blackforge. According to the scraps we have, he was intended to be part of the Assassin's League and be wanted by Undercity for the murder of the leader of the Deathstalkers. I liked this idea but thought:
 1) It would make more sense if he was wanted by the Assassin's League for this crime - trying to assassinate the leader of the Deathstalkers could bring an entire nation down on the League, who would not be capable of fighting a war against a true army.
 2) Wanton murder with witnesses (how else would UC be looking for Blackforge unless there were witnesses?) isn't in the style of a secret society that hides in the mountains and has gone to great pains to make sure they are largely unknown to the public.
 3) Why would Undead Rogue trainers pass on messages from an organization whose member(s) seem to attack the Deathstalkers?
 4) How can a level 23 mob reasonably kill a (presumably) level 60 or 63 mob?

This quest, [Redeeming the League](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) would immediately chain after the Detect Traps quest and would be immediately available from Farhad. It would address all four of the problems I mentioned and would be available to Rogues of every race. This would require 2 changes to Blackforge:
 1) He would have to drop [Cyrik's Head](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=7425/cyriks-head).
 2) He would have to become neutral to Alliance characters. I think this would make sense as he is stated to be a member of the Assassin's League in cut content but is not stated to be a member of the Alliance outside of the fact that he is currently in hiding with Alliance mobs. This DOES give an advantage to Alliance rogues, as they could just walk past any dwarven mobs in the area, but I don't think he is particularly THAT far behind any mobs to matter that much.

Completion of the quest would award the choice of: [Footpad's Shortbow](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) or [Footpad's Shoes](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

I'm open to rebalancing of the quest rewards, rewriting of any of the quest, etc. Constructive criticism is 100% appreciated!

I wasn't sure which Quest IDs and Item IDs in the recommended ID range have been taken already, so I left those fields blank. I can fill them in if needed.

Hello!
Runewalsh here. I hope i am  at the right place. And no im not going to say "Please forgive my bad English Yada yada yada" because... Ops already said it :P

This is a poor first draft of a quest, made with love but no skill. I had zero reference to start from, except the tips from a good member of this most excellent community (Thank you, Drag! )

Speaking of "a Drag", Dragunovi advised me on this - The implementation of this quest would require the creatures "Lord Falconcrest"  (ID 2597) and "Otto" (ID 2599) to be changed from monster type to Syndicate NPCs, like the rest of the mobs around them. Doing so should be relatively simple and would not affect the average player at all, since players are hated by the syndicate by default, and the aforementioned NPCs will attack them on sight regardless. However, without this small change, this quest is rendered meaningless and you can just disregard it entirely .

So, the rest of this post assumes that it is OK for staff to change the Syndicate master and his bodyguard into real syndicate members. Dump this quest otherwise.

This quest [The revenge of the Syndicate](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) is made to mirror what can be officially done with the Bloodsail Bucaneers reputation - To turn around the tables and work for the enemy, a tiring, long range goal that discourages most players, but can be enjoyable once you are fed of the normal game and up for a challenge. By declaring war on Ravenholdt Manor early enough in your adventures and slaying the Manor denizens, you are able to earn Syndicate reputation, and if you are persistent enough, become hated with the manor and neutral with the  dreaded syndicate, rather than the contrary.

This is known to be useless for anything but bragging rights. Well this quest aims to offset that and give a bit of use to a reputation counter Blizzard has abandoned.

The point of the quest is to visit Lord Falconcrest at Stromgarde (maybe thinking of collecting their bounty??) and, if done at neutral rep, finding all members of the syndicate and their leaders surprisingly tolerant of the player. This has been done before, but with the implementation of this quest, Lord falconcrest will have a "simple" mission for the syndicate candidate - To slay his most hated enemies. To this end, the quest requires the player to have Syndicate standing at Neutral.

The objective of the quest itself is something the player probably did before, in their quest to become neutral with the syndicate, making poor sense playability wise, but targeted at making sense in the eyes of Lord Falconcrest.

EDIT:

Suggested reward 1:  ["Falconcrest Oath"](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Also forgive me if any field of the editor is out of place, this is a first for me.

OPTIONAL: IMPROVING THE EXPERIENCE :

A ravenholdt mob kill earns you 5 Syndicate rep only, except for Myrokos Silentform, who is worth 25. That means a player will be stuck grinding rep for a very long time to get from hated to neutral. If staff has any mercy of a player who decides for this journey, here are a few ideas :

 1 - Raise the rep reward for Ravenholdt kills  a bit. It makes very poor sense that key members of the faction give the same rep  as the guards, other than the elf.

 2 - Decrease the respawn delay for the Ravenholdt mobs, especially the guards, turning the grind into a seamless experience. This would also benefit standard ravenholdt players, who wouldnt have to wait long for NPCS to respawn.

 3 - Allow the quest  ["Double-Crossing the league"](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) , set as a repeatable, given and received by the custom NPC ["Syndicate Eye"](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreator/WzAsMCwzNzE2LDAsMCwwLCJTeW5kaWNhdGUgRXllIiwiIiwwLDM1LDM2LDE0NTgsMTU0NywwLDAsMTQyNywzMSwyLDEsMS4xNDI4NiwxLDIwLDUsMCwwLDEsNzYsODgsMCwwLDEsMCwwLDQsMiwwLDEsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwxLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLCIiLDAsMywwLDAsMSwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwiIl0=) (No ID yet as it has to be approved first, so the quest giver and quest ender fields are blank) , to be placed somewhere near Stranhbrad (Alterac) or Northfold Manor (Arathi), far enough from the mobs as not to trigger a fight at fair level. This simple quest involves 10 Ravenholdt guard kills and rewards 500 syndicate rep, to be modded by staff as seen fit. If it seems like its too much, remember that the trek between the quest giver and the manor, on its own, is probably enough to even things out. The completion text of the repeatable is the players only hint about where to go afterwards, and when to go.

Im sorry to waste your time if this was long, and even sorrier for my own waste if this quest is somehow unaceptable ^^

## Post 7299 by Mac (Bug Report Enthusiast) — 2020-08-18T03:04:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7299#p7299 | page 5 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

> **Garish wrote: Tue Aug 18, 2020 2:02 am**
> hey torta i want to know how to put +5 sword skill in that item [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
>
>  i want to make a "off meta race" warrior item because edgemaster handguards is a 0,03 drop and is a must to every Dwarf,undead,troll,tauren,gnome,n-elf

You look for a spell that gives the effect you want.  For +5 sword skill, that would be [Increased 1H Sword (+5)](https://classicdb.ch/?spell=15896).  Then, you scroll down the item creator to spellid.  You put in the spell number, which you can find in the url (in this case, it's 15896).  Then, you change "on use" to "on equip."  The end result?  [Samuro's Gauntlets, now with +5 to swords.](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Greetings, everyone! Only just last night did I learn about Turtle WoW. For many years I've always wanted a "Classic+" experience as they call it nowadays. And while I am still playing Classic WoW, I must say I am quite impressed and glad to see people working together on a project like this.

And I absolutely love custom creator tools (for any game!) like what you have here. This tool is really great, creating custom quests and items is something I've often pondered about in my own head. So here's my first post and first question for this community, as the newcomer that I am:

Have you folks added unique loot to all the rare mobs out in the world? One of many disappointing / clearly unfinished parts of Vanilla WoW, is the rare spawns themselves. Only a handful of them have unique items / loot tables attached to them. While a lot of them instead just drop random green quality items around their respective level range. I've read the posts here so far and I love what Dragunovi's been doing with the items. I think my ideas are pretty in line with his designs.

Anyway, it's something I've always felt original WoW could've done better, so I'd love to create unique item drops for all the rare spawns out there that don't have them yet. Of course, it would be balanced items for the respective levels of the rare spawn.

I toyed with adjusting it to a proc on hit, but that really takes any -very limited- existing utility away from this item.

Instead your suggestion helped me come up with this idea:
[![Image](https://i.imgur.com/oRTxveN.jpg)](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

But I'm not sure if the spell is going to work correctly, since it's a spell used by NPCs on other NPCs. It would need to be tested. But it preserves the concept as a meme/pvp item, since it could situationally help you become immune to Gouges and Polymorphs while giving a nice boost to DPS. Also switched to trinket since it fits better there as an chance on hit buff item.

I never liked the absence of alliance Shadowfang Keep quests so I wanted to create at least one. I think a big benefit is also to help encourage some players to group with Paladins to go there for their class quest. I made the quest reward fairly enticing to promote grouping up with Paladins so they don't have to solo it later or miss out on it. I think it also is somewhat comparable to the Wailing Caverns quest that horde has which gives Blue rewards.

I found an unused NPC in Stormwind and decided to give him a bit of a story. Christoph Faral in the Old Town pub has been drinking away his sorrow for years. Go and have a chat with Christoph in the pub to receive a quest asking for revenge, [[The Southshore Merchant's Misery]](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).

He will send you into Shadowfang Keep, preferably with a Paladin on their class quest, to kill Razorclaw the Butcher as well as Fel Steed. When you return, he will reward you with one of 3 powerful swords he managed to snag during his own escape from there, either [[The Torment of Shadowfang]](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), [[The Turmoil of Shadowfang]](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!), or [[The Torture of Shadowfang]](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).

Stumbled upon that weird little goblin camp just west of the Wailing Caverns again as I do every few characters and thought "you know what, these guys need a reason to be out here!" so I opened the quest editor and took my first crack at designing a quest and its subsequent rewards.

It's the first time I've ever used the editors and while they're really helpful in their descriptors of what everything does I still wanted to post this stuff with the warning that I might have missed something important. The [quest](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~)  itself is to acquire the hides of [giraffes](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) and [zhevras](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) in exchange for some very fashionable [boots](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) or a [cloak](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) since I always found these two very unique mobs to be under-utilized in the zone and also conveniently tied together thematically via the world of fashion!

The only thing I couldn't really figure out was how to link the required hides to be dropped/skinned (preferably both) from the requisite mobs themselves while the quest is active. If there's a way to do that, I'd love to know! If not, the intended targets should be pretty obvious! If everything here looks good, I also have a planned follow-up to offer some late-teens weapons that would add some fun characterization to an otherwise wordless npc!

## Post 10083 by Mayson (Patch Note Conspiracy Theorist) — 2021-04-12T00:23:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10083#p10083 | page 7 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Made a little something that may lead to more or maybe not. The base idea is for a somewhat unusual satyr to offer the player character an unusual exchange (of words and gear alike) and to do a bit of world building on the process.
The quest rewards are meant to be polarizing, hugely boosting one aspect of a character and in turn strongly weakening other attributes - Making the items double-edged swords with a risk vs reward factor. If the idea takes off, I might add few more low and high level versions with appropriate stats to populate and diversify the item pool a little.

The quest ( [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... F4IjoxMH1d](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~~) )

The quest NPC in question ( [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreato ... wxOCwiIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) ) is supposed to be friendly/neutral and interactable (with shop if possible), but also attackable for higher level players to get rare rewards. So doubling as a special mob of sorts. Located anywhere in Desolace or Felwood, where it makes more sense for the Satyr to appear.

The challenge from the quest is to move from the quest NPC's origin to the Gadgetzan goblin trader selling the quest item and back in a timely fashion without dying. I set a timer of 30 minutes and the condition for failure on death, but the time may be further adjusted downward to increase challenge.

The Quest Item ( [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) ) should be sold in Tanaris, Gadgetzan, by any already established NPC. 51.00, 27.50.

Upon completion the player can choose between ( [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) ) and ( [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~) ) (not sure if it works, but the first equip effect of "The Voidstone of Sinister Tribunals" is meant to periodically hurt the player character who has the item equipped, not enemies).

## Post 10277 by Lightsvengeance — 2021-04-28T04:44:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10277#p10277 | page 7 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I have created the following submission to explore some of the Gnoll story line and lore. This initial plot picks up from the beloved Hogger in Elwynn Forest.

The quest starts with an [Unusual emblem](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) drop (100%) from Hogger. This item takes the player into an exploration to discover its origins and why the notable foe was holding up to this in the first place.

The plot explores an interesting Easter Egg from the [first Human campaign mission from Warcraft 3](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Defense_of_Strahnbrad_%28WC3_Human%29) , mentioning a character from an optional objective in this area of the game where the Player had to rescue a child from Gnolls.

It sets up a potential backstage influence from the gnolls in Alterac Mountains (from back in Warcraft 3) and how some of them potentially migrated to Elwynn.

The player starts off with the [Unusual Emblem quest](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) and progresses to investigate in the follow-up quest [Unusual Findings](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!). Finally, the final chapter of this short series is completed in [Unusual Motives](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!).

The whole quest happens in Elwnn and Stormwind. It also allows further story development to be built in the end of the final quest in the chain.

Discord: Willbreaker

## Post 10584 by Jacques — 2021-05-16T15:34:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10584#p10584 | page 7 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Imperial Qiraji Armaments: adding a **fist weapon**

This is a suggestion to add a fist weapon to the weapon rewards of the imperial Qiraji armaments quest. If you look at the weapons that were available in vanilla, fist-weapons are possibly the most neglected weapon type. Basically the only good one-handed and off-hand fist weapons available in game are either Rank 14 rewards, or the off-hand that is dropped from Sapphiron in Naxxaramas. All the other one handed and off-hand fist weapons available in game are Zg-tier or less (45 dps going down   crying_turtle  ).

With that being said, other weapon types get significant upgrades that are easily accessible to players. Mainly weapons that are deemed as good as r14 weapons, maybe slightly better but still not as good as naxx weapons. So I made sure to create a fist weapon that is as good as the other armaments quest rewards and a slightly worse weapon speed compared to the rank 14 fist weapon (2.7 vs 2.9). In terms of how good it is, it falls right between naxx tier weapons and BWL weapons, and it's a one-hander (both fist weapons available in BWL and AQ40 are main handers).

As for the weapon model this one is not yet used   turtle_tongue_head   : [https://classic.wowhead.com/item=20005/ ... aws#guides](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=20005/devilsaur-claws#guides)

Aaaand This is the link to the item I am suggesting   turtle_in_love_head
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

So I've been working on making some items I plan on adding to the profession tree's to be crafted, help add a bit of variety to the list. Right now I'm posting some sample staves I want to be added to the Enchanting Profession.

These first examples are simple ones that while I'd want to be learned from a trainer, I also have plans for a quest giver to sell them after finishing a quest if the previous option isn't possible.
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Then here is a stave recipe that'll be sold in limited supply by a vendor (perhaps the same one who sells the others should that prove to be the main method)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

This staff is 1 of two of my more ambitious staves, while limited in what I could use, the actual effect of the staff that I was thinking of goes as follows. "On Use: Create a Shield that absorbs 300 Damage and drains 2 mana per damage absorbed this way. While the Shield is active you gain 20 to all your resistances and have a 3% chance to reflect hostile spells back at the caster." The acquisition of the recipe for this staff currently between a long quest chain and or a random drop from high level dungeon bosses though I'm leaning towards the former more than the latter.
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Finally, this staff is again a result of limited options, though it's a bit simpler. The intended effect is to have an Aura that increases all nearby party members Spirit by 15. I definitely plan on this one's recipe being a quest reward, though more likely a short chain of 2 or 3 quests with low travel time.
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

I do plan on there being a little bit more, and I definitely want to make more for other professions, but I wanted to get a gauge on what I could and could not make. Hopefully I'm on the right track.

## Post 11609 by Greydawn — 2021-08-11T08:19:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=11609#p11609 | page 7 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

My goals & intentions for these quests:
- Undead players are given a quest about half way through TIrisfal Glades to speak with Belthor Iceshard in the Undercity, a similar quest in Goldshire introduces the Player to a few more quests they can do inside Stormwind, i.e; delivering wine, or linen, etc. This quest gives new forsaken players something to discover & do in the buried necropolis, while dumping a little dark forsaken exposition that otherwise isn't really explored until they do the Scholomance quest chain 45 levels later. The quest should fit well into the flow of the Forsaken questing experience, being done alongside Rear Guard Patrol, from Death Guard Leanna.

- Tirisfal is, pardon the pun, a bit of a dead zone? I'm new to the server, I understand Alliance seems to be the majority population as with most rp/pve servers. Compared to the experience I had leveling a Helf Paladin in Elwynn, well the contrast is a little stark. I want to add a bit of grandeur to Tirisfal, something which draws players in & is exciting. The Undead's very own Hogger, calling in players from across the world to aid in the beasts demise. Such a creature demands a worthy reward.

- Again I will say, the truly demented parts of the Scourge's & Forsaken's stories aren't touched upon very much, off the top of my head, The Scholomance dungeon & it's associated quests are really the only example I can think of from Vanilla. I feel these dark moments are good for the Forsaken story as it really rubs it in your face to remind you, these zombies, who are plaguing people & experimenting on people, do have a very awful, tragic backstory, and adds depth to them that isn't just "Ooh woo whacky zambie scientist man make silly goop slimes." or edgy "I feel nothing. Existence is sorrow. Sometimes I wonder how my family is doing, then I wonder why I no longer care." emospeech.

The Scourge are interesting when they're ripping out their hearts, trying to destroy the last remnants of their humanity, unable to escape the basic failings of their mortality. Arrogance, Pride, Wrath, Sloth. Even Arthas, after everything he did, still held onto Jaina's Locket, and still went back for Invincible, non canon as it may be to Turtle-WoW, the characterization is the characterization.

The Forsaken are interesting when they're doing everything they can to hold on to what remains of their humanity, against the gnawing curse of their undeath, every instinct telling them to blight the land, every moment the Helm of Domination is attempting to reassert itself. When the Will of the Forsaken overcomes their depression.

So, I wanted to explore Jeremiah Payson's relationship with his roaches. I feel like it maybe a little on the nose, but this is still Warcraft.

- With Undead Hunters presumably coming to the game with Undead pets, Cerberus would certainly be a must-have for any Beast Master's collection, again drawing players to the area, encouraging RP.

- The Balnir Farmstead, being the Grave of Invincible, is a pretty under-utilized part of the Tirisfal map. Death Guard Leanna sends you here to grind mobs, Forsaken mages come here to pick flowers, and there's a rare spawn here, who can be a real pita. This new quest makes doing these others a little more worth while, encouraging grouping to slay the undead.

Why did Arthas leave his favorite pet rotting in the ground, forgotten? He didn't, he left a guard dog to ensure no novice acolytes would turn his beloved invincible into the steed of some pissant. He fully intended on coming back(which he did in WoTLK,)with UC as his capital. He didn't know he would become bound to the Throne when he left.
________________________________________________________________________________________________

"You want to know why I care for these roaches?"

[The Roach Tenders Tragedy]([https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... F4IjoxMH1d](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!))![Image](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/small/929177.jpg) Another quest for everyone's favorite Roachman.
Hmm...before I begin; forgive me my failing mind. The events before the plague are hazy. The memories are like a blizzard, indomitable, opaque & biting.

Surely, you have seen the Abominations shambling about?
The broken souls & bodies of the dead, stitched together in a mad display of depravity.

After the plague took us, the Cult swept across the city like locusts, stealing from us what they liked best. They rode into town shrouded in their purple cloaks, atop their pale steeds & commanded us wordlessly with small flicks of their wrists.

All we could do was watch in terror as we were forced to turn on our surviving countrymen. We swarmed them like locusts, the pulp of blood & rot was all that remained.

When we were done dismantling our birthplace, after Arthas had left the second time for Northrend & The Undercity had been excavated the Cult's Skeleton Crew wanted to have a competition to test the extent of their cruelty.

We were nothing to them, they were like children, plucking the wings off of flies, giggling as we twitched & squirmed.

Unable to scream.
They mutilated us.
Violated us.

My friends, my brother. Their bodies were broken, torn apart piece by piece & molded into the shape of a hound. They sewed the heads on last & called them 'Cerberus'. (Emote: He spits.)
They were commanded like dogs. (Emote: He scowls)
Rip. Shred. Kill.

They were coming for me when the veil was lifted, and my mind was my own again. The Gates of Hell were swung open. Our shackles, broken.

I cannot describe to you the whirlwind of blood, pain, hate & rage that we were, twisting & screaming as we tore across the land that birthed us, destroying the evil that made us.

We were like locusts, shrouding the country, killing the ones we hated most.

The Cultists had not 'blessed' themselves with the same 'gifts' they had bestowed upon us. A few of us had been learned mages in life. They thought to return the favor.

(Emote: He grins and gestures towards a friendly abomination.)

Do you see this book? I took it from the one who broke my brother.
I spent an eternity pouring over this tome. Trying to find the words which would set my brother free. I prayed day & night for salvation, but there is no light in this forsaken place.

Then it came to me like a memory from my childhood.
It was so brief, a mere whisper in the back of my mind. I may've not noticed if the words were not branded onto my soul.

Do you see this tome? It is the Devil's bible. A guide-book on cruelty. On these flesh bound pages, written in blood are the words I spoke that ripped my brother's souls from the monstrosity they had been bound.

They didn't have any bodies to go back to, though. So I brought them these. (Emote: He gestures to the roaches which swarm around him.)

The only creature that still thrives in this festering land, feasting on the rot & sludge. Surprisingly smart little things, too. Do not pity them, they enjoy their new form.

Being as they are, however, I can no longer tell which are my brothers. So I am obligated to protect them all.

The others do not understand, they do not realize we are kin. Even the lowest rodent which carried the plague into our homes is a victim of The Prince, same as we.

________________________________________________________________________________________
(The spoiler text is intended to be gossip dialogue you click through as the goal of this first quest. I couldn't figure out how to make that happen though. I do not want it to be scripted dialogue you have to sit through like with the Alah'Thalas introduction quest in Stormwind, if a player wants to skip through it asap, they should be able to.

I understand that the text might be a little dark for Turtle-WoW's aesthetics, I tried really hard to keep this idea within the tone of Warcraft and in line with Scholomance. I also understand that this is a lot of text, please believe me when I say this is the heavily cut down & censored version of the concept.)

We do not get much characterization out of Jeremiah, but in the few times he's referenced we get the sense that he's looked down upon even in The Undercity, by other Undead, and he still cares when we mention to him his dead sister, threatening a "boot in our posteriors." if our intent is to disrespect his family.

How far does death's empathy extend? Is he actually just as vengeful, self serving & hate-bound as other Undead we meet? What is the Undead's relationship with other discarded, looked down upon things like themselves? What was life like for a mindless ghoul before they were free? Why did Arthas let his favorite Steed rot in the ground while he frolicked about Northrend? These 2 little quests attempt to address some of these questions, while letting others linger.

________________________________________________________________________________________________

Cerberus:[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/npccreato ... A0LCIiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[Slaying Cerberus]([https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... giOjEwfV0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!))
![Image](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/147772-gluth.jpg)
I am in no way, shape, or form a programmer, or skilled in maths. This NPC is almost certainly unbalanced & incomplete. I tried my best to just recreate Hogger, with a little undead twist.

The Bones:[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
(Bones dropped by Cerberus as apart of the quest.)

___________________________________________________________________________________________
The Rewards:
(Again, disclaimer; My maths are big bad. These items may not be properly tuned.)
Choice 1:![Image](https://i.imgur.com/9VN6voq.png)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Choice 2:![Image](https://i.imgur.com/jv0RP1W.png)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Choice 3:![Image](https://i.imgur.com/kJDYZ1W.png)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
(Helmets? With stats? At level 10? Insanity, I know.)

Let me tell you, that words cannot describe the happiness I felt when I made my Helf paladin, and I finished their rudimentary starting zone, and I was rewarded with a rose to wear in my hair. This has been the highlight of my time playing on this server so far, and then imagine my shock when I was awarded with ANOTHER helm in Elwynn Forest.
Perhaps this is a slippery slope? But if we can have aesthetic helmets at level 5, why not have low level statted helmets scattered about? They already sort of exist with the engineering goggles, but why should they get all the low level helmet fun? I feel like these helmets aren't particularly strong, maybe equally as strong as the engineering goggles, some stam, some main stat, lil bit of shadow res seasoning for the flavor.

I will concede however, these helmets all purely exist due to the fact that I came up with the mail one & it's flavor text first, I just have to have it, clearly I couldn't show my bias though, and made helms for the other armor types. If being common quality would get these into the game, I would be happy.

No Choice:![Image](https://i.imgur.com/FdGgxiV.png)
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
(Fleshcrafting: For Fools, is clearly a very powerful item. It casts rank 2 Drain Life, 10 levels before even warlocks themselves get it. I intended for this item to have a 20 minute cooldown or so, and I know cooldowns are not necessarily the way to balance an item, but in this case I do sincerely believe that this book is merely a strong flavorful tool to draw players in & be used to ease the leveling experience in a few tight spots for some classes. Warriors & Rogues come to mind. If it's better balanced without the shadow resist, or as rank 1, or with an entirely different use, then so be it.

The secondary intent is to undercut the dark tone of the quests with a little bit of humor. Jeremiah spends a long time trying to unlock the secrets of this black text, when it's really just a Necromancy for Dummies book that highlights Scourge incompetency. I feel this sort of humor is in line with Blizzards own.)

_________________________________________________________________________________________

In closing, I have been working on this for the worst part of the day.
It is 3am, English is my first language, I apologize for any grammatical mistakes, misplaced apostrophe's, incomplete NPC's or any other inconvenience or otherwise annoyance.
I sincerely appreciate & respect your consideration. I understand if my incompetence, or otherwise lack of Development resources, or a contradiction in developer goals means that this little quest chain cannot exist. The process of creation was fun & fulfilling, and I thank you Turtle WoW team for the opportunity.

 -Executrix Sorrowgrave/Justiciar Greydawn.
(PS: The chest piece, with the Purple Tabard that the Death Guards wear, is there any way this can be implemented into the game as an equippable item? If this were added to the donation shop under the tabards section, I would certainly be compelled to get one.)

I decided to test the waters and make a quest of my own. [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... giOjEwfV0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcreator/WzQzNDcxLDAsMiw0Nyw0MCw0Myw2MCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDgsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLCJQcmV5aW5nIG9uIHRoZSBQcmVkYXRvcnMiLCJTbywgeW91J3JlIGxvb2tpbmcgZm9yIHNvbWUgd29yayBhcm91bmQgaGVyZSwgbGFkZHk~~)

It's a short, one-off, traditional "kill X wolves" quest at the Hinterlands for Alliance, to give a purpose to the many, MANY wolves that litter the Hinterlands but serve no purpose for any sort of quest. In TBC, this was actually an official quest added in at Aerie Peak called "Preying on the Predators" and was given to a new draenei NPC in the region. But since there's obviously no such draenei NPC, instead the quest's given out by Falstad Wildhammer, the High Thane of the Wildhammer dwarves who wants you to get some "real work done" rather than acting as some chatterboxing errand-boy when you first meet him.

## Post 13071 by Aeliren (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2021-10-16T01:57:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=13071#p13071 | page 8 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Created a few quests for Alliance players based out of Silverpine Forest.

The first one is to kill Archmage Arugal in Shadowfang Keep, dubbed "The Madness of Arugal".

It should be given by Archmage Ataeric in Ambermill. I chose him in particular because I feel like there's not much around the Ambermill region in spite of being Alliance-aligned, aside from a few vendors. It's a bit out of the way, but any Alliance players exploring the world who end up in Silverpine will find a safe haven in Ambermill, and find Ataeric giving out a quest to kill Arugal*. Furthermore, lore-wise, Ataeric's affiliations to the Kirin Tor that Arugal deserted, in addition to Ataeric's close proximity to Shadowfang and Arugal, made it feel fitting.

 **Alternatively, there could just be a breadcrumb quest sending people to Ataeric if this is seen as too complicated.*

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... I6MTB9XQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

 **ITEMS:**

Head of Arugal
 *Not custom; same item as in "Arugal Must Die"*

 *REWARDS:*

Seal of the Kirin Tor
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... AsMCwxXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Dalaran Protector's Band
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wwLDAsMV0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

The next two is a simple quest chain revolving around aiding Dalin Forgewright in protecting the refugees at the Greymane Wall. For the first quest, dubbed "Culling the Moonrage",  he sends you out to kill some of the worgen that wander between the Greymane Wall and Pyrewood Village.

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... I6MTB9XQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcreator/WzE0MDIsIjEuMTUuMSIsMiwxMzAsMTQsMTYsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLDAsMCwwLCJDdWxsaW5nIHRoZSBNb29ucmFnZSIsIkxpc3RlbiBjbG9zZWx5LiBEbyB5b3UgaGVhciB0aGUgaG93bGluZyBpbiB0aGUgd29vZHM~~~)

The follow-up, dubbed "The Sons of Arugal", is slightly higher level and a group quest. Dalin tells you to gather your friends and sends you out to kill, surprise, surprise, some of the Sons of Arugal to send a message to the mad archmage. I'm not sure how many to put - one seems like not enough, but I also don't know how many can be spawned at a time, so I don't want to make it too tedious while also not making it too hard especially given how out-of-the-way it is, so right now it's at two Sons to kill.

As a reward, you get a weapon forged by Wallace the Blind.

[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/questcrea ... giOjEwfV0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

 *REWARDS:*

Greatsword of the Blind
[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... AsMCwwLDFd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
