## Post 13839 by Mac (Bug Report Enthusiast) — 2021-11-13T14:34:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=13839#p13839 | page 8 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I don't know if this has been brought up before, but it was not originally intended for either paladins or warlocks to get a free mount at level 40.  For whatever reason, the quests where these two classes would have earned their level 40 mounts were never completed in time for release, but were intended to eventually be added back into the game at a later date.  This never came to pass.

Proof of this can be seen in the quest text from both the [warlock](https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?quest=4490) and [paladin](https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?quest=1661) level 40 mount quests.

> I would give you a reward for your patience and hard work. But know this, the ability to summon a Felsteed will be much more difficult in the future. You will have to earn it... and it will not be easy.

> The time has come for me to bestow a great gift upon you. But know this, for now I give you this freely, but later, when time permits, this will be a much greater challenge to all paladins who choose to undertake my quest.

While doing research, I came across an interesting little area called Shadowbreak Ravine in Desolace.  Despite being a fairly fleshed out area with a bunch of buildings and mobs, and even being represented on the in-game map, there are no quests attached to this location.  And within this location, I found two interesting NPCs: a [Captured Stallion](https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?npc=13837) that looks like the summoned warhorse minus its barding (horse armor), and a [Burning Blade Nightmare](https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?npc=13836) that uses the same model as the summoned felsteed.  Both these horses are neutral and drop nothing when killed.  Further research found others speculating this area was to be used for the scrapped level 40 mount quests.

So with all that out of the way, here are some quests I wrote for more fleshed out level 40 mount quests.  The idea was to make these quests somewhat soloable but also require a social component by involving multiple different tradeskills (which would also add a monetary cost to the mount, but based on auction house searches, would still be much less than just buying your training).  These quests were also designed to be similar but also a little different, with the paladin one being about freeing a captured paladin horse, and the warlock one being about stealing and enslaving a demon horse from other demonlovers.  I also added a trinket as a part of the final reward to make up for the fact that these quests aren't freebies like they used to be.

[The Test of Nobility (1)](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[The Test of Nobility (2)](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~)
[The Test of Nobility (3)](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Rein It In (1)](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[Rein It In (2)](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Truesilver Barding](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[Cursed Feed Bag](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
[Lucky Horseshoe](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

This is all still very much a rough draft, so I'd appreciate feedback.  Additionally, if the idea of taking away the free mount is too much, it also possible to let players choose between doing the freebie quest and getting no trinket (and also living with the eternal shame of taking the freebie mount) or doing these quests and getting a nice little trinket that'll help them level.  Also as a note, if these quests are added, the Captured Stallion and Burning Blade Nightmare would probably have to be changed from neutral to friendly so you could right-click them and finish the quests without killing them.  And it'd be neat if the NPC horse actually despawned when you completed the quest.

<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=14252#p14252 | page 8 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

A quest

Require level 15

Starts and ends
Horde: Innkeeper Gryshka (Orgrimmar)
Alliance: Reese Langston (Stormwind City).

Title: Adventurous Spirit

Adventurous Spirit

Bring 5 Small Leather Collar, 5 Light Feather, 3 Sharp Claw, 3 malaquite and 3 tigerseye to Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

Bring 5 Small Leather Collar, 5 Light Feather, 3 Sharp Claw, 3 malaquite and 3 tigerseye to Reese Langston in Stormwind City.

Description

One of the things every adventurous must learn is to maintain strength of spirit.

When you immerse yourself in nature, dangers lurk and all kinds of creatures will want you to be their lunch.
But as important as that is to know the inert world that surrounds us and not fall prey to greed.

Prove that you are a true adventurous capable of dominating your spirit and the beasts of a hostile environment, as well as that you are able to dominate your greed.

Bring me 5 Small Leather Collar, 5 Light Feather, 3 Sharp Claw, 3 malaquite and 3 tigerseye. Then I will give you something to remember your feat.

Reward:
Adventurous Spirit.
 1000 exp.

Adventurous Spirit: Binds when picked up. Trinket. +5 armor, +2 spirit.

I have finally had the time to finish this (deleted the previous post). Hopefully I got all the variables, but probably missing something. The second to last quest also requires a timed explosive device, which might be a an issue. Not sure if there is an in game device already that can be used.

If anyone checks this, please point out any mistakes and I'll keep it in mind for later.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

For Id’s I just started with Zone ID and then 0001 after. For items, added a 1 to the quest ID.

The idea is a pretty simple quest chain involving the gnolls and silithid in eastern Feralas. Available to both Horde and Alliance.

Two new NPCs, the quest giver and his assistant. A bit to the north of the road coming from Thousand Needles. Would need a small camp area but devoid of stuff (as they have been robbed).

FERALAS QUESTS
Zone ID: 357

Melvyck Fandazzle

## Post 15731 by Qixel (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2022-01-13T04:43:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=15731#p15731 | page 8 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

So in Vanilla, there are lots of unique weapons that fill a cool niche or have an interesting effect that just don't have any upgrades. These weapons often fall of out favor simply by being outclassed in raw power by newer, higher level weapons, and I feel that's kind of a shame. I think the option to upgrade these interesting weapons would be fantastic. Not to the point that they are stronger than the higher weapons, of course, but to the point that the gap has been closed enough that you could justify using them for their unique functions.

That brings me to a custom NPC, Lorekeeper Chaesys (you can change the name if you want). Chaesys is a high elf, who has been around for millenia, and during his long life has seen many an interesting weapon. He's formed a fascination for weapons, and he's more than happy to help you improve an interesting weapon. He's currently hanging out by Karazhan, because that's surely where a lot of powerful weapons are held, which would also open up the possibility of using him for quests later, too. ;D The Dark Riders of Karazhan had been known to store interesting weapons in the tower, after all.

I've made one quest so far, to improve [Hurricane](https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=2824). Now, Hurricane is an interesting weapon; it has an above average speed, and a rare proc effect on a ranged weapon. These functions combine to make it a truly unique weapon, but its level limits its usability. As such, a quest to upgrade it to closer to Molten Core quality. Chaesys will send the player into the Stormwind Vaults to obtain a shard of Arc'tiras, the final boss, along with three nexus crystals to upgrade the bow into [Tempest](https://i.imgur.com/tLyw6Qu.png). *(Item linking seems to be broken atm, so I will link to a screenshot instead. Sorry for the inconvenience. D: )* The renewed bow gains 1% crit, ups its rate of fire by .1 second, and increases the dps to a level slightly below [Striker's Mark](https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=17069).
Code: Select all

```
**Previous quest:** None
**Title:** A Storm of Arrows
**Quest NPC (Start)**: Lorekeeper Chaesys
**Quest NPC (End)**: Lorekeeper Chaesys
**Quest level:** 60
**Required level:** 60
**Quest zone ID:** 41
**Main description:** Ah, Hurricane! A weapon of great power, but one that is, unfortunately, incomplete. Its true power has been lost to the ravages of time, the elemental magic that once powered it scattered. I saw it once, in my youth. It seemed to thrum with power, as the magnificent archer who wielded it seemed to fire arrows faster than the entire squad around them! It's how it got its name, you know? 'Hurricane', for the sight of the storm of arrows it seemed to let fly.
**\n\n**
I've lived so long, but never did I dream that I would lay eyes upon it once more. Please, champion! Assist me in returning it to its true, glorious form! To accomplish the feat, we'll need the essence of a powerful elemental, several crystals of arcane power to bind the essence to the bow, and of course, Hurricane itself.
**Short objective:** Obtain Hurricane, a Shard of Crystallized Storm from Arc'tiris, and three Nexus Crystals, and return them to Lorekeeper Chaesys in Deadwind Pass.
**Progress text**: Oh, champion! Please, tell me you've gathered the necessary components!
**\n\n**
I've heard rumor of a powerful being of ice and storm imprisoned within the Vaults beneath Stormwind; perhaps it would have the power we need to restore the mighty weapon...
**Completion:** Ahhh!  This curvature, this form, the elemental power that seems to hum as you pull the string! It's beautiful. Thank you, champion. To see this marvelous weapon restored to its full potential - nay, to heights greater than its peak! - makes this long life have been worth living. 'Hurricane' no longer seems an apt nomenclature for its power; henceforth and forever more, it shall be 'Tempest'! Go forth, champion! Go, use the great bow Tempest to darken the skies with arrows, to demoralize your enemies with the howling wind of the bowstring, to make sure all know the great power of the storm!
**Required items:** Hurricane, Shard of Crystallized Storm, Nexus Crystal x3
**— Rewards**
**Money:** None
**Reputation:** None
**XP:** 6150XP
**Items:** Tempest
**Additional notes:** If it would be possible for Lorekeeper Chaesys to only offer the quest to players who have Hurricane so that he doesn't just seem like a crazy old man shouting at clouds, that would be awesome, but I don't know how to go about that if it is.
```

If the concept is enjoyed enough, Chaesys could offer similar quests for other items. :D There's many cool weapons that fall off, after all.

## Post 17206 by Chnams (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2022-02-22T17:41:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=17206#p17206 | page 8 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

So after some discussion in the Paladin channel of the discord server, I came up with a fun little quest about a gnome with a dream. It's a level 29 quest that starts in the Citadel of Light with Brother Sarno about investigating a gnome that allegedly wants to become a paladin. He gets refused, though, so he makes a fuss, gets kicked out of the Cathedral and starts claiming that the priests and paladins are crooks. Also, he's talking some nonsense about... light particles? Your job is to go talk some sense into him and persuade him to leave.

The first quest is as follows (using spoiler tags as to not make the post extremely long):
Code: Select all

```
**Title:** The Confused Gnome
**Quest NPC (Start)**: 7917, Brother Sarno
**Quest NPC (End)**: Mimlooz Fizzlecrank
**Quest level:** 29
**Required level:** 25
**Quest zone ID:** 1519

**Main description:** %N? May I have a word? There’s been… somewhat of a commotion earlier today. A gnome, clad in some clothing that looked like a mix of fabric and gears, came into the Cathedral this morning, asking to be taken under the wing of Lord Duthorian Rall to be trained as a would-be Paladin. Of course, as you may know, gnomes are not exactly… “sensitive” to the Light, shall we say. They tend to be more inclined towards more earthly pursuits like creating intricate machinery or learning about the arcane. As such, we do not take them in for ecclesiastical training, and we prefer to redirect them to the Mage District. That is what Bishop Farthing told him then. So, after some back-and-forth arguing and the gnome spouting some nonsense about some “Light particles” that allegedly all of us holy men have in our bodies, the Archbishop himself asked the guards to escort him out as he was causing quite the ruckus. Now, he’s been banned from entering the Cathedral proper, but he’s still posted in the surrounding area, claiming to whoever will listen that we are “false holy servants” and “a disgrace to the Light itself”. I feel bad for him, I think he’s confused about the ways of the Light, but he is being very troublesome. Would you please go talk some sense into him? We don’t need someone scaring away the refugees and the future aspirants. Thank you.

**Short objective:** Find the Gnome outside of the Cathedral of Light.
**Progress text**: Yes, $r? What is it?.
**Completion:** What do you want? I'm very busy! The truth shall come out one way or another!
**Required creature kills**: None.
**Required items**: None.
**— Rewards**
**Money:**
**Reputation:** Stormwind: 25
**XP:** 150XP
**Additional notes:** No custom mechanics, just go seek out the gnome outside of the Citadel of Light in Stormwind
```

The second quest is this one:  Code: Select all

```
*Previous quest:** The Confused Gnome
**Title:** Confused? How Dare They!
**Quest NPC (Start)**: Mimlooz Fizzlecrank
**Quest NPC (End)**: Mimlooz Fizzlecrank
**Quest level:** 30
**Required level:** 25
**Quest zone ID:** 1519

**Main description:** Who sent you? The Bishop? Bah! I don’t need this! This whole church is a fraud! They claim to want to serve the Light? Ha! I wanted to, as well. You see, ever since I was but a young gnome, I’ve always wanted to become a Paladin. I dreamed of glory, of being able to serve the innocent, to heal the sick, and to smite evil. But no, my father wanted me to be an engineer, like his father and grandfather before him, so I could take over the family gizmo shop in Gnomeregan. So I begrudgingly became an apprentice in the ways of engineering and my dreams flew away. That is, until Gnomeregan became an irradiated nightmare overnight and we all had to flee. So, no more gizmo shop! I was finally free to pursue a greater calling! I immediately came to Stormwind, to the great Cathedral of Light, so I could finally receive the training I so wanted. But they refused me! On the basis that I am “just a gnome” and that “I don’t seem like a man of faith” and I must be “confused about the workings of the Light”. Confused? CONFUSED?! OUTRAGEOUS! THAT’S MY DREAM YOU’RE TALKING ABOUT! I’ll show them! I’ll prove to them that a gnome can be just as spiritual as any of them! It’s all about the Holychlorians, you see. Light particles! Every Paladin, every Priest, every holy man has those. That’s how you know they can become men of faith! And I’ll be damned if I let those… nincompoops!... get in the way of my true purpose! I’ll show them that I’m just as capable as they are! With SCIENCE!
Anyway, this is where my engineering knowledge will come in handy. Who knew it would actually help me reach my goal? Unfortunately, I lost most of my possessions when Gnomeregan became uninhabitable.I still have some things left, but I’m going to need more to make a device that will let me measure Light Particles. Let’s see… I’m going to need fabric, some power cores, and an iridescent pearl! I’d make the power cores myself, but I left all my tools in my home, like I said… Irradiated city and all that… If you’re not an Engineer, you can find someone who is and ask them to make you one. Or go have a look at the auction house, surely someone there will be selling one…Could I ask you to get all that for me? Please, help me, %N, you’re my only hope.

**Short objective:** Gather the reagants for Mimlooz's invention.
**Progress text**: Do you have the stuff? Please hurry, my dream is waiting!
**Completion:** That’s it! That’s what I needed! Oh, thank you so much! Here, I don’t have a lot left on me, but I’ll reward you however I can.
**Required creature kills**: None.
**Required items**: 10 Silk Cloth (4306), 2 Gold Power Core (10558), 1 Iridescent Pearl (5500)
**— Rewards**
**Money:** 40s
**Reputation:** Gnomeregan Exiles: 250
**XP:** 4000XP
**Additional notes:** No custom mechanics. Collect items and come back to the NPC.
```

The third quest would be this: Code: Select all

```
*Previous quest:** Confused? How Dare They!
**Title:** Holychlo-what Now?
**Quest NPC (Start)**: Mimlooz Fizzlecrank
**Quest NPC (End)**: Mimlooz Fizzlecrank
**Quest level:** 30
**Required level:** 25
**Quest zone ID:** 1519

**Main description:** Okay! With what you brought me, I have created a machine that will measure the level of Holychlorians in any given person! I call it the HOL-13R-TH-4N-TH-0U! Kind of a mouthful, I know. I need to work on the name, but that’s not our priority right now. Before I can prove to the fools at the Cathedral of Light that I’m perfectly capable of becoming a gnome of faith, I need to test my invention. But considering I’m still banned from the Cathedral, you’re going to have to do it for me. Here, take it. Use it on some of the practitioners of the Light around here, say a paladin of the Silver Hand, the high priestess, and the Archbishop himself, just to calibrate the device.

**Short objective:** Calibrate the HOL-13R-TH-4N-TH-0U.
**Progress text**: Well? Any results?
**Completion:** Great! Now that it’s calibrated, all that’s left to do is to point it towards myself and admire the results…
**Required creature kills**: Technically not kills, but here are the NPCs you need to use the item on: High Priestess Laurena (376), Duthorian Rall (6171), Archbishop Benedictus (1284).
**Required items**: H0L-13R-TH-4N-TH-0U
**— Rewards**
**Money:** 35s
**Reputation:** Gnomeregan Exiles: 250
**XP:** 3000XP
**Additional notes:** The quest should give you a usable item called [url=https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!]
H0L-13R-TH-4N-TH-0U[/url]. The item would ideally play a "zap" animation (think chain lightning but 0 damage) on the quest NPCs to signify that you're using the item on them. Additionally, for fluff, the item could say in chat "CLICK! Holychlorians detected! Calibrating..." when you use it on a quest NPC, and "CLICK! Holychlorians detected! Calibration complete!" instead when you use it on the final NPC. When you're done, return to the NPC.
```

At that point, the NPC should zap himself (same animation as for the previous quest), the device should say in chat "CLICK! Extremely high levels of Holychlorians detected!". Mimlozz should then play a "laugh" emote and say in chat “It works! Wait, extremely high…? I knew it! I knew this was my destiny! Beware, foul practitioners of the dark arts, for I, Mimlozz, will soon be a champion of the Light, ready to smite all evildoers!”.

The next quest then becomes available. It auto-completes as you accept it, you only have to turn it in. Mimlooz is very grateful and offers you a reward:  Code: Select all

```
*Previous quest:** Holychlo-what Now?
**Title:** The Chosen One
**Quest NPC (Start)**: Mimlooz Fizzlecrank
**Quest NPC (End)**: Mimlooz Fizzlecrank
**Quest level:** 30
**Required level:** 25
**Quest zone ID:** 1519

**Main description:** It worked! It worked! Did you hear? It says I have extremely high levels of Holychlorians in my body! I knew it all along! Ever since I was a child, my dreams of honor, of helping the innocent, of curing the ailing, of vanquishing the darkness! I really was destined for something greater than taking care of the family’s stupid gizmo shop! Take that, father! “You’re not fit to be a Paladin”, “You’re too smart for adventures, follow the family trade instead”, yeah right! Now you’ll see what I’m truly capable of!
I’m going to show these results to Lord Duthorian Rall. He seemed to be the most reasonable out of all of them, surely he’ll understand and he’ll help me achieve my true destiny! Thank you so much for your help, %N! You helped a poor gnome who lost his home to realize his dreams. And for that, you deserve a reward. Like I said before, I don’t have much left since Gnomeregan, but I can give you this. I won’t need that for my new career after all!.

**Short objective:** None, the quest auto-completes
**Progress text**: None, the quest auto-completes
**Completion:** None, the quest auto-completes
**Required creature kills**: None
**Required items**: None
**— Rewards** . You can choose between [url=https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!][Irradiated Gnomish Pendant][/url], [url=https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!]Workshop Gloves[/url], [url=https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!]Overheated Arclight Spanner[/url] and [url=https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!]Mimlozz's Custom-Made Ring[/url]. If the rewards are overtuned, they can of course be adjusted. I would've liked the Workshop Gloves to give a +5 to Engineering but I couldn't figure out how to do that in the item editor. I'm also not sure how useful that would be, so it could be turned into +5 to Mining instead, maybe.
**Money:** 35s
**Reputation:** Gnomeregan Exiles: 250
**XP:** 3750XP
**Additional notes:** None.
```

The questline ends here. I have ideas on continuing Mimlooz's story at a much higher level in the Western Plaguelands, but that's for another time. I sprinkled some obvious Star Wars references in there as this whole questline came up because of a discussion about Star Wars. However, I think it doesn't stand out too much from the Warcraft universe, just read the quest text and you'll see what I mean. Gnomes have crazy ideas after all.

I hope I formatted my post properly this time. It's also the first time I use the server's item/NPC/quest creation tools and the first time I actually try to create a quest for WoW, so I'd love some feedback on this! :)
And if it somehow makes its way into the game, well, I'd be overjoyed :D

## Post 23806 by Jam — 2022-08-28T11:30:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=23806#p23806 | page 9 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

> **Kwayver wrote: Fri Aug 26, 2022 10:40 pm**
> Any chance of a spell/ability creating tool?

Dragunovi spoke to this quite often prior to the goblin/helf expansion. Using spells that are already in game or reactivating features that blizzard canned is doable but adding custom spells and/or recipes is much more involved and there's a much higher risk of it wildly unbalancing classes, specs, or even NPC's. I don't believe it has ever been said that it is impossible but I think the reward for adding abilities doesn't outweigh the risk.

I plan to make quests for all Zepellin Masters/Dock Masters, with a title for completing them all(if admins allow it).
Here is the first. The text was already there, and it's always felt like a quest to me.

Note: the reward is a little high for the level to compensate player for buying sausage
_______________________________________________________________________________
Quest start lvl 10

Zapetta

Buy sausage in org bring back

Rew 4s

Title: Meats for Zapetta
Quest NPC (Start): Zapetta Zeppelin Master
Quest NPC (End): Zapetta Zeppelin Master
Quest level: 10
Required level: 8
Quest zone ID: 45
Main description: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.
Short objective: Buy a haunch of meat in Orgrimmar, then return to Zapetta.
Progress text: Got the meats?
Completion: Finally some damn real food.

Required items: Name.
— Rewards
Money: 2s40cXP: 810XP

_________________________________________________

<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=24949#p24949 | page 9 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I don't know how I would get this submitted, but here it goes:

I was thinking about having a 3 wing instance near Bootybay that would be a series of instances that lead into each other.

The first instance would be about Booty Bay being sieged by the Bloodsails and sending the group back to the deadmines to get the dreadnought to break the Bloodsails blockade.

The second instance would be after the dreadnought destroys the blockade (along with itself) and the group has to clear out the remaining Bloodsails around the port and capturing their last remaining ship.

The third instance would be taking that captured ship and assaulting Plunder Isle from the south and defeating Duke Falrevere.

I have ideas on how to make the instances without needing new assets, I just don't know how to get the idea submitted. Also have an idea on how to make a version like Dire Maul Tribute for those who went for the Bloodsail faction.

<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=25614#p25614 | page 9 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

> **Xudo wrote: Tue Sep 20, 2022 4:48 pm**
> There should be a quest to make more detailed investigation of Mankrik's wife death.
>  Maybe she is alive and faked own death to run from her husband.
>  Maybe it is her husband killed her and asked us to "find" her.
>  We don't really know how things were actually happened.

From "Lost in Battle":
> We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated—she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.
>
>  I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds—he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

I think it's pretty clear that she died from being overwhelmed while fighting quillboar and that Mankrik was knocked out in the fighting. I don't think anything needs to be added, and I don't see the use or point in retroactively making Mankrik the villain of the quest.

> > We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated—she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.
> >
> >  I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds—he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.
>
>   I think it's pretty clear that she died from being overwhelmed while fighting quillboar and that Mankrik was knocked out in the fighting. I don't think anything needs to be added, and I don't see the use or point in retroactively making Mankrik the villain of the quest.

Perhaps not making him villain but more like a followup in which you need to acquire her spirit bead from the quillboar then using it at a specific altar ( ontop of the wc mountain?) to have a talk with her ghost
After that return to Mankrik and have a final part to avenge her death by killing the murderer in RFK.

<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28838#p28838 | page 9 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

In Felwood there's a questline to free the night elf Arko'narin from captivity in Jaedenar. Along the way she gets the sword Lightforge that was used by her deceased paladin friend Trey Lightforge, and I expected it to be a reward from the end of the chain but it's not.

I think it'd be great if Arko'narin were made an NPC in Darnassus and then after the completion of the chain she sends a mail to the player asking them to come meet her, where she then gives them the sword Lightforge, probably a blue item considering the chain is pretty long and difficult and currently only provides underwhelming rewards.

If someone more experienced with the tool could put this together, I think it'd be a very cool moment to end a chain that's often overlooked and make it a bit more worthwhile.

## Post 32517 by Moriena (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2023-01-13T07:05:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=32517#p32517 | page 9 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Hello everyone!

I've been working on a questline involving the unused night elf NPC Sentinel Keldara Sunblade in the Haldarr Encampment in Azshara - she has (presumably) a sister in Darnassus' Temple of the Moon, who also serves no purpose atm.

The questline follows the adventurer accepting Dalia's request to look for her sister Keldara, who left Darnassus for Ashenvale on an investigation of sentinel abductions, which ultimately lead to Azshara. The adventurer meets with Captain Arrowsong (custom NPC) and finds Keldara's body for her amidst a satyr camp, realizing that her soul has been taken. Captain Arrowsong tells the player to look for clues in Keldara's journal and with that, they are able to find a wounded satyr - the reason for her actions. The satyr Xanarem (custom NPC) is someone who knows Dalia and Keldara from even before the Sundering - not being able to avenge her himself, he requests assistance of the adventurer to retrieve the souls of the satyr victims off of Master Ol'vrir (custom NPC enemy) and eventually, save them in the process.

I tried my best to work around with the dev creation tool, but I do not have enough experience with it, so instead of half-heartedly scrambling something together, I wrote a document containing all information, questtext, NPC spreadsheets and rewards.

Azshara questline: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PtC ... sp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PtCbYa85IOhMSl9dGbBbg6nfgjsRbCewtYc9DGhEhog/edit?usp=sharing)

smiling_turtle_head

## Post 33082 by Kefke (Patch Note Conspiracy Theorist) — 2023-01-24T12:21:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=33082#p33082 | page 9 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I had a silly little idea for a quest, but I haven't quite got the utilities down. I tried my best.

The general idea was that somewhere out in the world would be an invisible NPC with a large and meandering patrol route. If you find them, you will see that they are Breeze Shadowhoof, a female Tauren with the Rogue class, and appropriate gear. Talking to her, you'd get the dialogue; **"Wait...you are talking to ME? You SAW me?"**

And they would have an available quest; **There are no Tauren rogues** [(Link)](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

In addition to the small amount of faction rep and experience, the player would get a **[Satchel of Coins](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)**. In addition to random gold, the **Satchel of Coins** would also give the player a **[Mysterious Satchel](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)**.
